# Taraxa Studio

> Taraxa Studio is a small software studio based in Indonesia. Tagline: "A Simple Software". We make small, focused apps that do one job well. Founded by Ribhararnus Pracutian.

The name comes from Taraxacum, the Latin name for the dandelion, which is also the studio's mark.

## Products

- [NovelOS Studio](https://novelos.studio): The operating system for storytellers. Plan, write, and publish a novel in one place. Runs on Windows and macOS, plus Android and iOS as an installable web app (PWA). Price: $45 one-time, lifetime personal license. Features: plot, scenes, and timeline; a cast of characters linked into the manuscript; maps and worldbuilding notes; a calm full-screen editor; word goals; export to eight publication formats; files stay local and offline.
- PixelOS Studio: In progress. For indie 2D artists and 2D game developers. A pixel art editor with a tilemap editor, 8-bit music, and managers for FX and HUD assets.
- TypeOS Studio: In progress. For typographers and type foundries.
